race.title: Midnite Golden Rose Stakes (Listed)
race.verdict: CRESTOFDISTINCTION arrives at the top of his game and is 2 from 2 on all-weather, so has plenty going for him. Soldier's Tree is the obvious threat if back to the level he showed when placed in the Wokingham, while Ain't Nobody responded very well to the switch to all-weather when just failing in a Group 3 at Dundalk and is also respected in what is a strong listed event. CRESTOFDISTINCTION SOLDIER'S TREE (IRE) AIN'T NOBODY (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Crestofdistinction (9/4), Soldier's Tree (5/2), Montassib (5/1), Ain't Nobody (8/1), Beckford's Folly (10/1), Partisan Hero (10/1), Zen Diva (10/1), Hollywood Treasure (33/1)
